cohort: The study utilized a physiologically based pharmacokinetic (PBPK) model to simulate drug disposition in pregnant subjects and their fetuses.
finding: The developed PBPK model accurately predicted maternal and fetal drug exposure of cefuroxime, cefazolin, and amoxicillin during pregnancy and at delivery, falling within 2-fold of observed values.
gest_age: The model incorporates physiologic changes and predicts drug exposure across the entire course of pregnancy and at delivery, for any gestational age.
